description: Sovereign AI governance for MOD defence estate sustainability. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. UK-sovereign, audit-grade, MOD-compatible. EU AI Act Article 50 compliant.

Audit-grade. Signed. Renewable energy procurement. Energy efficiency AI. Heating, lighting, and power optimisation. Smart metering. Buildings MOD Estate Asset Management Building condition monitoring AI. Biodiversity MOD Conservation & Biodiversity Defence estate biodiversity net gain. SSSI management on military land. Conservation covenants. Protected species monitoring AI. Flood risk management for coastal and riverside bases. Waste MOD Waste & Circular Economy Defence estate waste reduction AI. Hazardous waste management (ammunition, fuel, chemicals). SFA condition monitoring. Housing satisfaction tracking. Decant and relocation planning. Accommodation standards compliance.
